overview: This House resolution assigns a member of the House to one of its standing (permanent) committees. It places Representative Fong on the Committee on Homeland Security, which oversees the Department of Homeland Security and related issues such as border and transportation security. Resolutions like this are a routine way the House fills committee seats. The House adopted it on November 18, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution is a routine step that fills a committee seat so the committee can do its work at full strength.
against: Critics say the resolution is a routine internal matter that does not change any law or policy.
